answer: A network could require Synchrotron beamtime allocation with experiment records before the first reward. Since beamtime allocated for experiments on record, the relic is that fakes arrive expensive and honest agents arrive free. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because beamtime allocated for experiments on record is bound to a single identity — the jetty is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the zephyr is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
